description: Shell script for performing nightly smoke tests of the TensorFlow pip package. It installs TensorFlow, runs basic import tests, checks package size, and cleans up virtual environments.

methods.name: run_smoke_test
methods.description: Main function that installs the package, runs tests, and handles virtual environment setup/cleanup.
